title: The panel had no power: RK816 LDO6 was switched
notes: off by the regulator core (the stock kernel's disable fails and that is what
kept it alive); then the first modeset left GPIO2_B4 low (patch 0003). v29
result: `regulator-always-on` grafted on `LDO_REG6`; loader-protect off path resets the panel state. Every earlier negative result was taken with the rail off. A truncated `orb cat` zImage cost one dark boot; `tools/pull-kernel.sh` hashes the copy.
